entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God of victory and the Iroan Games, praised in the ode.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: Polis hailed as preeminent in war, home of the Iroan Games.

entities.name: Pandamator
entities.description: Akroan athlete and pankratist, champion of the Iroan Games and child of Iroas in the ode.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God to whose realm the disgraced fall.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God whose forge is named in the ode.

entities.name: Iroan Games
entities.description: Athletic tournament in Akros won by Pandamator.

events.summary: Pandamator is hailed as champion of the Iroan Games in Akros, and Iroas is asked to bless him.

relations.note: Pandamator is addressed as Iroas's child.
